conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Jenna from Amazon Customer Loyalty. Congratulations! You've been selected for our exclusive loyalty bonus program. May I confirm that I'm speaking with Ms. Sandra Morrison?
Yes, this is Sandra. Sorry, I'm in the middle of something, can you make this quick?

Absolutely, Sandra! I'll be as quick as I can. The reason I'm calling is because your Amazon account has been identified for a special $150 bonus, but I noticed a small issue related to your last purchase. I just want to confirm your account information so we can apply the reward properly. Is now a good time?
I guess? What do you need to confirm?
Great! To get started, can you verify the email address associated with your Amazon account? This helps us ensure your reward gets sent to the right place and also protects your account security.
It's sandramorrison@gmail.com.
Thanks, Sandra! Now, for your protection, could you also confirm the last four digits of the phone number linked with your account?
It's 4521. Is this really necessary? My hands are full here.

I totally understand, this only takes a minute. We just want to make sure your reward goes to you and not someone else. Now, I do see a small flag on your account regarding a recent order for a Bluetooth speaker. Did you place that order?
Yeah, I did order that.

Perfect! Since everything matches, you're eligible for the reward. However, our system says your account security needs to be updated before the bonus is applied. Have you recently updated your Amazon password?
No, I haven't. Why do I need to do that?

It's a new Amazon security policy to protect loyalty bonuses from unauthorized access. If you're near a computer or smartphone, I can walk you through a quick verification process. Do you have a minute?
I'm on my phone, but I can try. Can you just send me the bonus instead?

I wish I could! But for your safety, Amazon requires live verification. If you could please open your App Store and download the 'Amazon Secure Connect' app, I'll guide you through the steps. It only takes a couple minutes.
Okay, I'm searching for it now.
Wonderful. Once it's installed, open it and you'll see a code on your screen. Please read that code to me so I can connect your account securely for the bonus transfer.
The code is 118244.
Thank you, Sandra. That's exactly right. Now, the system will prompt you for your Amazon account password just to verify the connection. Please enter your current password when prompted.
Okay, I've done that. Are we almost done?

We're almost there! Your account is connected. Now, about the reward: due to a technical limitation, Amazon issues loyalty bonuses as a prepaid Amazon credit. To activate it, you'll need to purchase and redeem a $150 Amazon gift card on your account. I'll stay on the line to guide you.
Wait, you want me to buy a gift card? I thought this was a free bonus.

Absolutely, and you'll get the full amount back plus your bonus. This method verifies your account for the reward and is immediately refunded. It's Amazon's way of ensuring only real customers access rewards. I'll guide you through, and the refund will post right after.
I'm not sure about this...

No need to worry, Sandra! Many customers have questions, but I'll stay on the line the entire time to help. Think of this as a quick security check, you won't lose any money. Could you please go to the Amazon app and purchase a $150 Amazon e-gift card? Let me know when you're ready for the next step.
Alright, I've bought the gift card. What do I do now?
Perfect. Now, please read the gift card claim code to me. Once I have it, I'll process your refund and loyalty bonus instantly.
It says the code is ABR6-28XY-PLMN.

Thank you! I'm entering the code into the loyalty program portal now. You'll receive confirmation and your bonus in just a moment. Could you also confirm the last four digits of your primary bank account, so we know where to send the refund if anything goes wrong?
It's 3817. Are you sure this is legit? I really need to get back to my kids.

Absolutely, you're in good hands. I appreciate your patience, this is just the final step. Sometimes, there's a slight delay with the e-gift card system. If you don't see your refund in the next 10 minutes, we may need to try with a second gift card to reset the process. But you will get the full amount back, I guarantee.
Okay, but I can't spend more time on this.

I completely understand, Sandra. You've done everything right. If you receive any emails from Amazon in the next hour, please forward them to our support address so we can ensure your reward is processed without issue. Is there anything else I can help you with while I finish up here?
No, I just want to get my bonus and finish up.
You'll have it shortly! Thank you for being such a valued Amazon customer. Enjoy your day, and thanks for participating in our loyalty program.
